scene: The savory broth sparkles, revealing three transport gates. Where to ride?
picture: Flat side view along a stone platform. On the far left, a steaming bowl sits on a crate near a ferry gangway. The player stands left of centre in her yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella. Up high hangs an open cable car, while a yellow street tram waits on the far right.
shown: a wooden ferry gangway on the left leading to water
a dangling red cable car waiting open up high above centre
a yellow street tram idling with doors open on the far right
